desc.zh: 一块 GPU 有上万个「核」，每个都比 CPU 的核笨得多。它是怎么把一张图、一次矩阵乘法拆给这么多笨核同时做的？为什么同一段代码，写法稍微一变，GPU 上能慢好几倍？十个可以动手的模型：缓存和多线程两种藏延迟的办法，把一张图映射到网格、线程块和线程束，线程束调度器逐拍模拟，H100 一个 SM 能养多少线程束，分支发散，合并访存，共享内存的 bank 冲突，分块矩阵乘法的两级屋顶，各种数字格式下张量核心的峰值，以及把三角形光栅化成 2×2 像素组。
desc.en: A GPU has tens of thousands of "cores", each far simpler than a CPU core. How does it split an image or a matrix multiply across so many of them at once? Why can the same code run several times slower on a GPU after a small change in how it is written? Ten hands-on models: caches versus more threads as two ways to hide latency, mapping an image onto a grid of blocks and warps, a cycle-by-cycle warp scheduler, how many warps one H100 SM can hold, branch divergence, memory coalescing, shared-memory bank conflicts, two roofs for a tiled matrix multiply, tensor-core peaks across number formats, and rasterising a triangle into 2×2 pixel quads.

title.zh: 两种花晶体管的办法：缓存，还是更多线程
title.en: Two ways to spend transistors: caches or more threads

desc.zh: CPU 用大缓存和乱序执行让一个线程少等；GPU 同时养很多线程，一个在等就换另一个。拖命中率和线程数，看两种机器各忙多少。
desc.en: A CPU spends area on caches and out-of-order execution so one thread waits less; a GPU keeps many threads and switches when one waits. Drag the hit rate and the thread count to see how busy each machine is.

en: why GPUs have so many cores
how does a graphics card work

title.zh: 网格、线程块、线程束：一张图怎么拆给两百万个线程
title.en: Grid, block, warp: splitting an image across two million threads

desc.zh: 程序员只写一个像素怎么算；硬件按块分给 SM，每 32 个线程切成一个线程束。选图和块的形状，看要多少块、多少线程白跑、某个像素落在哪个线程束。
desc.en: The programmer writes how one pixel is computed; hardware hands blocks to SMs and cuts every 32 threads into a warp. Pick an image and a block shape to see how many blocks, how many idle threads, and which warp a pixel lands in.

zh: CUDA 网格 线程块 线程

desc.zh: 调度器每拍从准备好的线程束里挑一个发指令。逐拍模拟要多少线程束才能藏住显存的几百拍，再看 H100 的一个 SM 被寄存器、共享内存卡住只能养几个。
desc.en: Each cycle the scheduler issues from one ready warp. A cycle-by-cycle simulation shows how many warps hide hundreds of cycles of memory latency, and how registers and shared memory limit what one H100 SM can hold.

zh: 寄存器太多 占用率低

title.zh: 分支发散：一个线程束走了两条路
title.en: Warp divergence: one warp, two paths

desc.zh: 32 个线程只有一条指令流，在 if 上分开时两条路都要走一遍。拖走 if 的比例，看效率怎么掉。
desc.en: A warp has one instruction stream, so when its threads split at an if, both paths run in turn. Drag the share that takes the branch to see the efficiency fall.

zh: GPU 上 if 为什么慢
en: why if statements are slow on GPU

title.zh: 合并访存：32 个地址，几次读
title.en: Memory coalescing: 32 addresses, how many reads

desc.zh: 一个线程束的 32 次读按 32 字节一段取。挨着读取 4 段，按步长读最多取 32 段。改访问方式，看搬来的字节用上多少。
desc.en: A warp's 32 loads are served in 32-byte sectors: adjacent addresses need 4, a stride can need 32. Change the access pattern and see how much of the moved data is used.

title.zh: 共享内存的 bank 冲突

desc.zh: 共享内存分成 32 个 bank，每个 bank 每拍交出一个字。按步长读，看几路冲突；32×32 的块按列读，补一列就不冲突。
desc.en: Shared memory has 32 banks, each delivering one word per cycle. Read with a stride to see the conflict degree; reading a 32×32 tile by column conflicts until each row gets one word of padding.

zh: 共享内存 bank 冲突

title.zh: 分块矩阵乘法的两级屋顶
title.en: Tiled matrix multiply: two levels of roofs

desc.zh: 先搬一块进共享内存，再搬一小块进寄存器反复用。选块大小和每线程的小块，看显存、共享内存和峰值三层哪一层先压下来。
desc.en: Stage a tile in shared memory, then a smaller block in registers, and reuse it. Pick the tile size and per-thread block to see which of three roofs (memory, shared memory, peak) binds first.

title.zh: 矩阵乘加指令与数字格式
title.en: Matrix multiply-accumulate instructions and number formats

desc.zh: 一条 MMA 指令让整个线程束算一小块矩阵乘加；格式越窄峰值越高，但矩阵要够大才喂得饱。选卡、格式和矩阵大小，看能跑多快。
desc.en: One MMA instruction has the whole warp compute a small matrix multiply-accumulate; narrower formats have higher peaks, but only large matrices can feed them. Pick a GPU, a format and a size to see the speed.

title.zh: 像素按 2×2 着色：小三角形为什么费
title.en: Shading in 2×2 quads: why small triangles cost

desc.zh: 顶点和像素也变成线程上 SM，像素按 2×2 一组着色。拖三角形大小，看盖住的像素和要跑的线程差多少。
desc.en: Vertices and pixels also become threads on the SMs, and pixels are shaded in 2×2 quads. Drag the triangle size to compare the pixels covered with the threads run.

title.zh: GPU 的存储层次，和不做的一致性
title.en: The GPU memory hierarchy, and the coherence it skips

desc.zh: 每个 SM 有自己的寄存器和 L1/共享内存，全片共用 L2，再往外是显存。各 SM 的 L1 之间不做硬件一致性，跨块交接要靠原子操作和栅栏。
desc.en: Each SM has its own registers and L1/shared memory; the chip shares an L2, then device memory. The SMs' L1s are not kept coherent by hardware, so handing data between blocks needs atomics and fences.

zh: GPU 为什么不做缓存一致性

title.zh: 前沿在哪（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: Blackwell Ultra、Rubin、MI355X 和 MI455X：格式更窄、峰值更高、显存跟不上；双芯片封装；CUDA 与 ROCm 的版本。
desc.en: Blackwell Ultra, Rubin, MI355X and MI455X: narrower formats, higher peaks, memory that cannot keep up; two-die packages; CUDA and ROCm releases.

title.zh: 写 GPU 代码前问三件事
title.en: Three questions before writing GPU code

desc.zh: 拆得开吗、走得齐吗、读得近吗：把前面各章收成一张清单，再指向讲内存、缓存和互连的各篇。
desc.en: Can it be split, do the threads move together, are the reads close: the chapters condensed into a checklist, with pointers to the essays on memory, caches and interconnects.

zh: 怎么写快的 CUDA 代码
en: why is my GPU code slow
